title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 2: Turn of the Golden Witch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The second arc of the Umineko murder mystery, adapted from Ryukishi07's visual novel, replays the Ushiromiya family gathering on the island of Rokkenjima from the servants' side. Maid Shannon, taught that servants are mere furniture, has found love with grandson George through a bargain with the witch Beatrice; her brother Kanon distrusts the witch and refuses her offer. As the night of the murders approaches, the story asks whether a witch is real or the killings have a human explanation.
life_message: Love makes a person fully human, but bargains to escape one's station carry a terrible price, and readers must decide between magic and logic.
